The season began on 2 February and ended on 8 December. [[Cerro Porteño]] were the defending champions. In the Torneo Apertura, [[Club Olimpia|Olimpia]] won their forty-first league title with two matches to spare following a 2–1 win over [[Club Libertad|Libertad]] on 30 May.{{cite web|url=http://www.abc.com.py/deportes/futbol/olimpia-libertad-apertura-2018-1707774.html|language=es|publisher=[[ABC Color]]|date=30 May 2018|title=Olimpia conquista la 41}} Olimpia also clinched their forty-second league title in the Torneo Clausura with two matches to spare after beating [[Club Guaraní|Guaraní]] 4–1 on 28 November.{{cite web|url=http://www.abc.com.py/deportes/futbol/julian-benitez-rompio-el-cero-1763878.html|language=es|publisher=ABC Color|date=28 November 2018|title=¡Olimpia es bicampeón!}} ==Teams== ===Stadia and locations=== {{Location map+ |Paraguay |float=right |width=300 |caption=Locations of the '''2018 Primera División''' teams |places= {{Location map~ |Paraguay |lat=-25.35 |long=-57.42 |label=
